messages.subject: Bootstrap values from newick format
parts:
Dear professor Yu,

I am a junior for ggtree.  I have met the ploblem for showing boostrap in the tree.

I have run the code below, but its error.  So I have also tried my IQ-tree, it still wrong.
nwk <- system.file("extdata/RAxML","RAxML_bipartitions.H3", package='ggtree')
tr <- read.tree(nwk)
ggtree(tr) + geom_text2(aes(label=label, subset = !is.na(as.numeric(label)) & as.numeric(label) > 80))
Result
> nwk <- system.file("extdata/RAxML","RAxML_bipartitions.H3", package='ggtree')
> tr <- read.tree(nwk)
1: ggtree(tr) + geom_text2(aes(label=label, subset = !is.na(as.numeric(label)) & as.numeric(label) > 80))
2:

my own tree
> ggtree(tree) + geom_label_repel(aes(label=bootstrap, fill=bootstrap))
Error in FUN(X[[i]], ...) : object 'bootstrap' not found
Hope for you reply sincerely.
Best wishes.

Dear professor Yu,

Sorry for my question.
        The first example was provided in your handbook. I run it using your code in the book as below but failed to get the bootstrap. The second example was provided in attachment.
First example:(Code)

nwk <- system.file("extdata/RAxML","RAxML_bipartitions.H3", package='ggtree')
tr <- read.tree(nwk)
ggtree(tr) + geom_text2(aes(label=label, subset = !is.na(as.numeric(label)) & as.numeric(label) > 80))
Running result:

> nwk <- system.file("extdata/RAxML","RAxML_bipartitions.H3", package='ggtree')
> tr <- read.tree(nwk)
1: ggtree(tr) + geom_text2(aes(label=label, subset = !is.na(as.numeric(label)) & as.numeric(label) > 80))
2:

Second example(Code):
tree<-read.newick("example")
ggtree(tree) + geom_text2(aes(label=label, subset = !is.na(as.numeric(label)) & as.numeric(label) > 80))

Running result:
> ggtree(tree) + geom_text2(aes(label=label, subset = !is.na(as.numeric(label)) & as.numeric(label) > 80))
Warning messages:
1: In FUN(X[[i]], ...) : NAs introduced by coercion
2: In FUN(X[[i]], ...) : NAs introduced by coercion
3: In FUN(X[[i]], ...) : NAs introduced by coercion
4: In FUN(X[[i]], ...) : NAs introduced by coercion

Hope for you reply sincerely.
Best wishes.
